targets.query:
from(bucket: v.bucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "emote_usage_1m" and r._field == "count")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.channel_login =~ /${channel:regex}/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.stream_id =~ /${stream:regex}/)
  |> group()
  |> sum()

from(bucket: v.bucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "stream_activity_1m" and r._field == "chat_count")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.channel_login =~ /${channel:regex}/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.stream_id =~ /${stream:regex}/)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1m, fn: sum, createEmpty: false)
  |> group()
  |> max()

base = from(bucket: v.bucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "stream_activity_1m")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.channel_login =~ /${channel:regex}/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.stream_id =~ /${stream:regex}/)

total = base |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "total_emote_count") |> group() |> sum() |> findRecord(fn: (key) => true, idx: 0)
seventv = base |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "seventv_emote_count") |> group() |> sum() |> findRecord(fn: (key) => true, idx: 0)
array.from(rows: [{_time: now(), _value: if total._value > 0 then float(v: seventv._value) / float(v: total._value) * 100.0 else 0.0}])

minutes = uint(v: (uint(v: v.timeRangeStop) - uint(v: v.timeRangeStart)) / uint(v: 60000000000))
points = from(bucket: v.bucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "stream_activity_1m" and r._field == "chat_count")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.channel_login =~ /${channel:regex}/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.stream_id =~ /${stream:regex}/)
  |> group(columns: ["stream_id"])
  |> count()
  |> group()
  |> sum()
  |> findRecord(fn: (key) => true, idx: 0)
array.from(rows: [{_time: now(), _value: if minutes > 0 then float(v: points._value) / float(v: minutes) * 100.0 else 0.0}])

from(bucket: v.bucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "stream_activity_1m")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "chat_count" or r._field == "total_emote_count" or r._field == "seventv_emote_count")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.channel_login =~ /${channel:regex}/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.stream_id =~ /${stream:regex}/)
  |> group(columns: ["channel_login", "stream_id", "_field"])
  |> sum()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["channel_login", "stream_id"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with reaction_score_0_100: if r.chat_count + r.total_emote_count <= 0 then 0.0 else float(v: r.total_emote_count + r.seventv_emote_count) / float(v: r.chat_count + r.total_emote_count) * 100.0}))
  |> sort(columns: ["reaction_score_0_100"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 20)

from(bucket: v.bucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "emote_usage_1m" and r._field == "count")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.channel_login =~ /${channel:regex}/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.stream_id =~ /${stream:regex}/)
  |> group(columns: ["channel_login", "stream_id", "provider", "emote_id", "emote_name"])
  |> sum()
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_value"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 25)

from(bucket: v.bucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "stream_activity_1m")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "chat_count" or r._field == "total_emote_count" or r._field == "seventv_emote_count" or r._field == "viewer_max")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.channel_login =~ /${channel:regex}/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.stream_id =~ /${stream:regex}/)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1m, fn: max, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "activity")

from(bucket: v.bucket)
  |> range(start: -24h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "stream_activity_1m" and r._field == "chat_count")
  |> group(columns: ["channel_login", "stream_id"])
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({channel_login: r.channel_login, stream_id: r.stream_id, last_export: r._time, minutes_since_export: int(v: (uint(v: now()) - uint(v: r._time)) / uint(v: 60000000000))}))
  |> sort(columns: ["minutes_since_export"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 50)

list.definition:
channelSel = "${channel}"
isAllChannel = channelSel == "$__all" or channelSel == ".*"

from(bucket: v.bucket)
  |> range(start: -__STREAM_LIST_DAYS__d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "stream_activity_1m" and r._field == "chat_count")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => if isAllChannel then true else r.channel_login == channelSel)
  |> group(columns: ["channel_login", "stream_id"])
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["stream_started", "_time"], desc: true)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      _value: r.stream_id,
      _text: (if exists r.channel_login and r.channel_login != "" then r.channel_login + " ? " else "") +
        (if exists r.stream_started and r.stream_started != "" then string(v: r.stream_started) + " ? " else "") +
        (if exists r.stream_title and r.stream_title != "" then r.stream_title else r.stream_id)
    }))
  |> keep(columns: ["_value", "_text"])
